items.title: Rio de Janeiro (RJ) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 3 #24
items.en_title: Rio de Janeiro (RJ) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 3 #24
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Rio de Janeiro (RJ) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through accreditation (credenciamento); proposals close Dec 3, 09:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
